value.answer: That sounds like a lot, and it makes sense to want someone to talk to. The free option in Toronto is Ontario Structured Psychotherapy, which offers free CBT for depression and anxiety. You don't need a health card or a family doctor, and you can self-refer at ontariohealth.ca/osp. It isn't right for everyone, and I couldn't find which local network serves Toronto or how long the wait is. There are also low-fee counselling options, such as training clinics where supervised students see clients for about $45 to $50 a session, and an online option at about $65, but those prices may be out of date and I couldn't confirm anyone is taking new clients right now. If things get urgent, call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department.
